Description
🌵 The Desert Room 🌵

A calm, grounding bedroom inspired by soft desert tones and natural textures. Located downstairs, this spacious room is bright and peaceful, with warm earthy colors and an open, airy feel. It features a large working desk, making it ideal for remote work, creative projects, or longer stays.

Thoughtfully styled and quiet, the Desert Room feels cozy yet expansive — perfect for someone who wants a comfortable, inspiring space with easy access to the rest of the house.
